reviews.text:
Refinishing our dated fiberglass pool has been at the top of my list for AT LEAST a couple of years.
Finding the right contractor to work with was even higher on the list.

As a single parent household, I’ve looked not only for a cost-efficient solution, but for service & craftsmanship.

I made 3 calls.
Texas Fiberglass Pools felt right from the start.  They made my call a priority.
Oliver came to visit my home and was polite, knowledgeable, sensitive to my needs & eager to work. He came out Friday, said we could start Monday and finish in 4 days. He more than delivered. The team showed up at 7am each of the days they worked in my home and were polite, happy & pleasant to be around.

Working from home off my dining table, I could see that they were paying attention to every detail & wasted absolutely no time.

Making sure that I do my part by helping someone else make their decision is truly the best way I can express my gratitude.
We now get to enjoy our newly refinished fiberglass pool for years to come.

PS - It's also noteworthy that there was really no trace of them being in my home, outside of the fact that my pool has been transformed.

Thank you, thank you, thank you!
reviews.author: Liliana Muir

reviews.text:
After we found out our pool had pool cancer we were referred to Oliver and Texas Fiberglass Pools. They have been nothing short of exceptional. We had the pool repaired, resurfaced, coping stones redone, tile grouted and the crew has been the best throughout the entire process.TFP comes highly recommended from this lifelong customer!!
Kudos to Oliver, Zule and the entire crew!
reviews.author: Steven Grimm

reviews.text: Texas Fiberglass Pools is absolutely amazing they did a beautiful job on my pool the deck and a whole lot more. They truly go above and beyond. Their customer service is absolutely outstanding. I would highly recommend them for all your pool needs.
reviews.author: Catrina Curtis

reviews.text: Can I give 10 stars?? We inherited a pool with major issues. One call to Oliver & his team at Texas Fiberglass Pool set me at ease. They immediately understood our issues, annd our vision of what we wanted, and even came to us with several options to make our finished pool a dream! Their crews worked quickly (despite a ton of rain) to get our project completed. Looking at it now, after watching the process, I am amazed at what they were able to do in the time it took. They stayed on schedule, and within budget. If you are looking for the right group to take care of your fiberglass pool, Texas Fiberglass Pools is the only call you need to make!
reviews.author: Sara and David Cooper

reviews.text: After having had bad experiences with several other pool  companies, we were hesitant to dive in and allow yet another company to come in and tend to the multiple issues we were having with our pool. Our pool was very poorly installed in the first place and to keep our story short, we won’t go into details. It was an ugly mess, though, and the original pool company accepted no responsibility! After searching for many months, we finally found two companies who agreed to tackle the job. One company suggested “putting a bandaid on it” to hide all the problems with an estimated cost of $5000 to $10,000 in addition to a promise from us of a fabulous 5 star review. The other company, Texas Fiberglass Pools Inc., told us exactly what had to be done to “fix” the problem and refused to take any shortcuts. They wanted to get to the details of what caused the problems in the first place and do a major costly repair. Yes, we were hesitant at first and were tempted to go with the company that gave the lower bid, but in our gut we knew that was a very temporary solution.  After several conversations with Oliver and Zule of Texas Fiberglass Pools Inc., we were convinced they were the right company to do the work. Something about them made us feel confident we could trust them and that they would do all they could to please us and get the job done right. Yes, it was a lot of work, costly, and time consuming. Do we feel like we made the right decision? Absolutely!!! Zule was always just a text or a phone call away. She was always reassuring. Always understanding and patient. Always explained the details. Oliver was professional, knowledgable, patient, and obviously very experienced. The workers were punctual, pleasant, polite and worked hard and efficiently. Texas Fiberglass Pools Inc. definitely earned Five Stars and we are very happy with the outcome of our pool repair.
reviews.author: Bette Felder

reviews.text:
We bought a home with a 15+ year fiberglass pool that needed some TLC.

Oliver and his team put a new layer of fiberglass over the entire pool and a fresh gel coat.  Lines and structure were tested, which has given us great piece of mind.  They replaced the aging pumps and filters.  Basically, our pool is like new.

Everything purrs and is ridiculously quiet compared to the old equipment.  The new tile and pool look amazing.

The Texas Fiberglass Pools team is top notch.
reviews.author: Bobby Welch

reviews.text: The pool looks great! Logan was very professional and helped with any questions we had during the process. The repair crew was efficient and did a great job cleaning up afterwards. Would definitely recommend Texas Fiberglass Pools Inc.
reviews.author: Tray Park

reviews.text:
I have a large, old, inground fiberglass pool. One section collapsed. After contacting this company, I met with a representative, Logan.    I was relieved to learn that my pool could be repaired at a cost that I could afford. And, it became apparent to me that he knew what he was talking about.

The workers worked diligently in extremely hot weather and it quickly became apparent that they knew what they were doing. They removed the damaged sections of fiberglass, installed support structures, reinstalled sections of fiberglass, gel coated the entire pool, replaced the caulking in the deck around the pool etc.

My pool was restored and they cleaned up after themselves. I've  since learned that their services are in high demand not just through out Texas, but also in all surrounding states.
reviews.author: William Perlman

reviews.text: Excellent job.  Logan Wentz was my contact. Less that one month from my initial email asking for information to a completed project.  Pretty good I think!  Bottom line is they did exactly what they said when they said.  The installation crew were VERY had working, very polite and very organized.  I could not be more pleased.
reviews.author: Joe Prichard

reviews.text:
The folks at Texas Fiberglass Pools are family! Oliver, Suzy and their team saved my cracked and damaged fiberglass pool when I was ready to give up on it.

My pool had shifted significantly during a severe storm last fall. It was separated from the gravel base - and I was afraid it could not be saved.

Oliver and his crew came in and repaired cracks, leveled the pool, rebuilt all the plumbing and applied a new gelcoat. They also installed a new concrete surround - all in about five weeks. It looks better now than when it was originally installed!
reviews.author: Dennis Houghton

reviews.text: We had some small leaks after the summer, but Oliver and his company honored the warranty and now we are ready for another hot Texas summer! Logan was responsive to my texts and calls. Mauricio did a great job!
reviews.author: Jean-Prieur Du Plessis

reviews.text: I’ve been doing business with Texas Fiberglass pools for about 10 years recently had a leak in my pool and my pump would not  prime when the skimmer line was open. Contacted Oliver he sent a leak detection person out and found the leak. They replaced my skimmer and a pipe which  was all under the concrete. Once the parts was replaced poured new concrete and sprayed the texture and painted it. Their team was very professional and respectful always cleaned up after themselves. My pool is 38 years old and Oliver and his team are so helpful when I need something fix!
reviews.author: Tammy Green

reviews.text: I have had some bad experience with pool companies. I will tell you these men do what they say and do an amazing job. Come in work pick up after each day. Go over and beyond what they have too. I will definitely call them for future needs with my pool. Not very many men left in today's time that actually do what they say. Job well done.before and after pictures. The before pictures are from work that was less then a year ago
reviews.author: Troy Thompson

reviews.text: Had our pool and entire deck refinished by TFP.  What a great job the crews did.  Was a pleasure to work with Logan as he was always available for any questions and great about keeping us updated as project progressed.  Highly recommend this company for anyone needed fiberglass pool support.
reviews.author: Thomas Pickle

reviews.text: We have used Texas Fiberglass Pools for many years. Good honest/reputable people, that do quality work on a timely basis. They aim to please.
reviews.author: Gary Timbes

reviews.text:
Texas Fiberglass Pools is an excellent company. My pool in San Antonio had a crack in it and I began the process of gathering quotes for repair. Logan with Texas Fiberglass Pools knew just from my description over the phone where the crack would be and talked me through all the possible repair options depending on how much bowing/expanding had happened to the pool wall.

After I sent over some pictures, I had a fair quote in my inbox and they were ready to go. I don't want to speak badly of the other companies, but they lost the bid mainly due to the speed and professionalism from Logan and Texas Fiberglass Pools. Once I gave the go ahead, they were scheduled and the repair done within a couple of days.

Great company to work with. These guys know their work and are great at it.
reviews.author: Dan Sullivan

reviews.text: Great service and communication by Oliver and his whole team. The crew worked long hours everyday until the pool was completed. The office team was also helpful through the entire process, before even starting our project! We were so stressed about all of our issues and Texas Fiberglass Pools instantly put us at ease! Plus - our pool is now beautiful and problem free! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Liz Magur

reviews.text:
Professional Service, Excellent Work
We have known and worked with Oliver Gonzalez, owner of Texas Fiberglass Pools, since 2007.  He has always been honest to work with, takes pride in doing the best job he and his company can, and strives to give his customers an excellent work result.  We worked with his Project Manager, Logan Wentz, during a complete fiberglass redo, rock coping repair, and deck repair and painting this past January (2023); and during some leak repairs (not related to their other work) in November, 2023.   Logan was very professional to work with, was easy to contact and communicate with, and went the extra mile to make sure our job was done properly and completely.  We could not recommend a company higher than we do Texas Fiberglass Pools, and  we look forward to working with them for many years to come.
reviews.author: Larry Mendolia

reviews.text: If you are building a pool, or need your fiberglass pool repaired/refinished, Texas Fiberglass Pools is the best! Our 37 year old pool was repaired, and had a new fiberglass finish in two weeks. It looks brand new, and is so much more inviting than our old pool! Oliver and his office staff are amazing, and very responsive with any questions or concerns. The crew working on the pool was just as amazing. They worked tirelessly in the unbearable Texas heat to make sure the pool was repaired correctly before the new finish was applied. I highly recommend Texas Fiberglass Pools.
reviews.author: Betsy Beall

reviews.text: Excellent company.  Crews are skilled craftsmen who take pride in their work. I have used this company for my pool maintenance over many years.  They are consistent in delivering every time.  Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael Felix

reviews.text: Oliver and his team are absolutely amazing. Project went smooth with no issues. Excellent craftsmanship, work ethic, communication and their customer service is top notch. Couldn’t be more pleased with the finished project and highly recommend Oliver and Texas Fiberglass Pools for pool repairs.
reviews.author: S Stephens

reviews.text:
Extremely satisfied and have already recommended Texas Fiberglass Pools to my neighbors.  Oliver came out and provided an estimate for tile replacement  in a very timely manner.
Pricing provided was fair and we agreed to start the project.

Once my wife and I selected the tile, work started the next day - a welcome surprise.  Oliver's team has been great.  On time, quality work, and as much as they can, clean as they go.

We made a few small changes of scope and Oliver made some recommendations during the project - with again - very reasonable pricing or no affect on the original pricing.

Pool looks outstanding!
Oliver and his team are on point.  I'd give them six stars, but apparently 5 is the top of the scale.
reviews.author: Frank Walker

reviews.text: This is the second time I have employed Texas Fiberglass Pools for a project on my pool. The first was 4.5 years ago for an extensive leak repair and fiberglass overlay on my plaster pool. Just recently I had them return for some tile/grout work.  On both occasions I worked directly with Oliver (Owner) for the consultation and estimates. My second experience was similar to the first. Absolutely professional in demeanor and execution. I must have been asked a half dozen times over the two days' work if I was happy with the progress. And , yes, at every point I was. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Mike F

reviews.text: The best solution for my cracking gunite pool in shifting Texas clay soil has been Texas Fiberglass Pools. Over the years I have had them do a complete resurface, skimmer replacement, pipe leak repair, and regrout. They to do the job right and their work holds up great. Their experienced crewes have always been fast and professional in every way.
reviews.author: Guinn Unger

reviews.text: I had Texas Fiberglass Pools revamp and refinish my pool recently and they did a superb job! It was a wonderful experience!  They were expert in advising me with solutions, the prices were outstanding and the crew was so professional! This is typically a messy and lengthy process, but they made it painless. The guys were on the job promptly and Oliver was always available by phone to answer any questions I had. The follow up is also fantastic. I have recommended them to others and everyone thanks me for this referral. I would gladly recommend them to ANYONE that wants great service and excellent expertise. THANK YOU TEXAS FIBERGLASS POOLS! You are the best! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
reviews.author: Judith Winchester

reviews.text: Texas Fiberglass Pools came out to resurface our pool deck and it looks great! Oliver came out and gave me an estimate and work started within the week. His guys were on time and did a great job! I was told the work would take about 7 days and it was done in 6 days! I highly recommend Oliver and his company Texas Fiberglass Pools. Great guy with a great company!
reviews.author: Sylvia Kayata

reviews.text: We needed a resurface on our pool.  We called Texas Fiberglass Pools and Gabriel came out, listed to our needs, took measurements and we discussed the details of the work to be done.  Before he left, we agreed on the scope of work and the cost.  I considered the cost reasonable and the work was scheduled.   He and his crews started work during the heat wave during which the temp hit 108.  In spite of the heat, the crews worked taking water breaks as needed to continue work in the extreme heat.  Gabriel and his crews did a great job.  Our pool looks great and we asked for further help in conditioning the fill water.  We are very satisfied with the attention, courtesy and work done by Gabriel and his crews.  Also, Oliver, the owner visited with us to assure we were satisfied.
reviews.author: Tony Vega

reviews.text: My first project with Texas Fiberglass Pools was a few years ago. They replaced the cement for the deck, replaced the tile. Removed and put on a new fiberglass surface. The workers did a great job but were a little messy, nothing out of the normal. Oliver personally worked on the pool and checked in frequently with me on progress and satisfaction. We ran into problems with black cobalt dots showing up on the surface a couple years down the road. The pool was under warranty and Oliver graciously honored that warranty and resurfaced the fiberglass. This past year the surface began to show black dots again. Oliver once again honored his warranty and the pool looks beautiful and earned a 5 star review. Thank you TFP!
reviews.author: Cheryl N

reviews.text:
Gabriel came out to give me an estimate for leaks in my pool.  He was ahead of schedule and called to see if he could come earlier, which was perfect for me.  He was extremely personable while being specific as to the problems he saw, as well as suggestions for rectification.  We agreed on time-frame, cost and procedures to be completed.  The day the work began, the crew got a great deal done.  Day two, they hit a bump in the road...another leak!  Oliver came and assessed the issue and updated
the estimate.  Gabriel also came out that day.  Although they were mot doing the repairs, they were still attentive and visible during the work being done.  The work crew did an excellent job.  My pool looks the best it has in 25 years.  When they were finished, they cleaned my back yard so as though you never knew they were ever there!  I passed the info along to my pool cleaning company in case they have other customers who need help with fiberglass pools.  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND Texas Fiberglass Pools!
reviews.author: Toni Jackson

reviews.text: I was very impressed with Texas Fiberglass pools. Fiberglass pools are not as common in Texas as they are in Florida. I found most pool stores don't even have a recommended contractor. After doing some research I found there are four main contractors in the DFW area. I had Gabriel give us a quote a few years ago when we bought the house. I never got around to getting the pool redone until this past April. He came back out, gave us an updated quote. I had another quote from another company about the same price and a third quote that was much cheaper. I went with Texas Fiberglass pools because of their professionalism. Gabriel stayed in complete communication during the project. The workers showed up at 8am and left around 5pm, cleaning the site up everyday. We were delayed a couple days because the tile we ordered was not in stock locally. They expedited the shipping and had it ready in three days. I only wished I had them do the coping around the pool. I will have them back out this winter to complete that task. Highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Jason Gass

reviews.text: Texas Fiberglass Pools made my 30+ year pool look like new again. The pool had to be leveled, bulges removed, resurfaced, new skimmer and many other repairs. The work started as soon as contract was signed and the crew arrived everyday until the job was complete. Everyone was nice and very professional. I would recommend this company for anyone looking for pool repairs or updates.
reviews.author: Marilyn Anderson

reviews.text:
Absolutely stunned by this amazing company.

Tell me, do you enjoy paying a lot of money for something and not getting the absolute best experience? Me neither. Which is why Gabriel and his team are the absolute best. Let's face it...Pools are expensive. You need to make sure you're getting bang for your buck. Texas fiberglass pools does amazing quality work and their customer service is beyond comparison. At one point during this process, Gabriel showed up at my house at 7 am just to accommodate my work schedule. You cannot get better than these guys. Period.

I'm looking forward to continuing our partnership when we redo our entire patio and deck. Some good friends of ours had theirs redone by them, and it looks AMAZING. We had the fiberglass conversion, new pool equipment, tile work, and salt water conversion all done at once and we LOVE our pool now! You should've seen this wreck of a pool when we bought the house. Ugly 90s mosaic, broken plaster with structural cracks, you name it. Gabriel and his team transformed this thing from the black lagoon into a verifiable masterpiece.
reviews.author: Lance Hemby

reviews.text:
Texas Fiberglass Pools converted our plaster pool to fiberglass, changed our deck from aggregate to cool deck and installed a new pool filter. In every instance, they did a superb job. They are thorough, professional, and attractively priced. I highly recommend them. We're very happy with the products of their fine work.                                          S. Bach
Fort Worth, TX
reviews.author: Matt Bach

reviews.text:
They covered up a old pool that
was well built 50 Years ago. This
Pool was at my son’s home.They removed all the cool deck around
the pool. The steel used in those
days was a lot larger than what
is used now days. They over came
all the problems they encountered
and did a great job. After they
Finished they packed the dirt in
the pool down and had enough
dirt to make surface appear like
the rest of the yard.
I have used this company in the
past when my Fiberglas  pool
Came out of the ground. They
did a great job two years ago.
I would recommend this company
for any pool problems you might
have.
reviews.author: TF MCLEAN

reviews.text:
This experience started with Gabriel who evaluated the cost and time involved with what needed to be done.  We signed a contract that day.
His crew started work in three days.  The work was done in 7 days.  The pool and spa were re-fiberglassed and we also had plumbing problems to repair.  The crew was wonderful and the yard was picked up and cleaned every day.  The pool is filling as we speak, and the grandkids have discovered they can use the pool as a slide to the deep end during the process.  We are really happy with this company and will call them again as needed.
reviews.author: Jim Baird

reviews.text:
Worst Service -Totally Unprofessional, don't go with their rating .

I hired Texas Fiber Glass Pool people to  fix my hot tub , because their Google rating was good . Oliver came and gave me quote f around $7000 to fix the spa.  once they started the work,  they start adding more money and ultimately ends up around $19000. First of all they didn't pull the permit. One of their  totally unprofessional guy start working and install VAC alert at wrong place , when I pointed that issue then they fixed it . after one week they told me work is done and start asking money without even testing .  when we tested  and found that  they didn't even install any jet body , Owner Oliver accepted  that and agreed to redo everything again , second time they install wrong jet bodies.  jets are not working and water was coming out of air pipe..

Totally unprofessional people .

Reply :-  Job is not completed yet, nothing done extra , Spa is still leaking.
reviews.author: Baymont By Wyndham

reviews.text: Beyond satisfied with the work and customer service from Texas fiberglass pools. Logan came out to my home and we made a deal and the next day there were guys in my yard working. Just amazing. The work was beautiful and I couldn't be more impressed. Thank you Texas fiberglass pools
reviews.author: Abigail Contreras

reviews.text:
I had a large inground pool that had a liner. It was destroyed, and after calling numerous pool repair companies, Texas Fiberglass was out VERY quickly to give me a quote.
Yesterday they completed the pool restoration, and I must say, I didn't realize how nice it was going to look.
Huge thank you to the teams at Texas Fiberglass. Highly Recommended!!!
reviews.author: Sean Callinan

data.summary: Reviews appear largely authentic from real customers. Positive reviews are detailed and varied. The primary red flag is a serious, specific complaint about cost overruns and permit issues, which aligns with the BBB's 'C+' warning. There is no strong evidence of widespread review manipulation, but the business may have issues with project management and communication on some jobs.
fake_signals: Some 5-star reviews are generic and lack specific project details (e.g., Catrina Curtis, Tray Park)
Limited negative review sample for analysis

negative_evidence: The 1-star review implies a lack of accountability for work quality and permit oversight
positive_evidence: Reviews mention crews fixing issues and standing behind work (e.g., 'repaired cracks, leveled the pool')

authentic_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews contain specific details: crew names (Oliver, Zule, Logan), project types (repair, resurfacing, coping), timelines, and weather challenges
Varied writing styles and perspectives (single parent, inherited pool, old pool repair)
The 1-star review provides specific, credible allegations (price jump from $7k to $19k, permit issue, VAC alert mistake)
Reviews span 8 years, indicating a long-term presence
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are generally consistent. The BBB C+ rating is a warning but reflects complaint handling, not a direct contradiction of the positive service reviews on Google and Angi.
